scripts.test:e2e:api: bash -euo pipefail -c 'cd apps/api && rm -rf .cache/covdata && mkdir -p .cache/covdata && go build -cover -o .cache/api-cover ./cmd/api && go test -coverpkg=./... ./e2e/... ./internal/... -args -test.gocoverdir="$PWD/.cache/covdata" && go tool covdata textfmt -i=.cache/covdata -o=coverage.out && cp coverage.out ../../coverage.out'
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && cd apps/api && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.codegen: cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/openapi > ../../contracts/openapi.yaml && cd ../web && pnpm openapi-typescript ../../contracts/openapi.yaml -o src/types/openapi.d.ts
